# Supply: MESACLIP to the coupler

*Generated by Claude.*

What DATM, DOCN and DICE send the coupler and how each field is made from MESACLIP. What the models
use is on [Demand: what the models import](stream_data_requirements.md); the files are in
[MESACLIP experiments](mesaclip_experiments.md#files-and-history-streams).

## Flags

- {bdg-info}`computed`: calculated in the `mesaclip` datamode from other MESACLIP variables.
- {bdg-primary}`h4`: from `cam.h4` (6-hourly means); other atmosphere fields are from `cam.h2`
  (6-hourly snapshots).

## From MESACLIP to the coupler

One stream per MESACLIP variable. Ocean variables are from `pop.h.nday1`, ice from `cice.h1`. Line
links go to the datamode source.

### DATM

| Coupler field | Meaning | How it's made | From MESACLIP | Line |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Sa_u`, `Sa_v` | Lowest-level wind, zonal and meridional | direct | `UBOT`, `VBOT` | [276–277](datm:L276-L277) |
| `Sa_z` | Height of the lowest atmosphere level | direct | `ZBOT` | [271](datm:L271) |
| `Sa_tbot` | Lowest-level air temperature | direct | `TREFHT` | [272](datm:L272) |
| `Sa_shum` | Lowest-level specific humidity | direct | `QREFHT` | [273](datm:L273) |
| `Sa_pbot` | Lowest-level pressure | direct | `PS` | [274](datm:L274) |
| `Sa_pslv` | Sea-level pressure | direct | `PSL` | [275](datm:L275) |
| `Faxa_lwdn` | Downward longwave | direct | `FLDS` {bdg-primary}`h4` | [310](datm:L310) |
| `Faxa_swvdf` | Downward shortwave, visible diffuse | direct | `SOLSD` {bdg-primary}`h4` | [312](datm:L312) |
| `Faxa_swndf` | Downward shortwave, near-IR diffuse | direct | `SOLLD` {bdg-primary}`h4` | [311](datm:L311) |
| `Sa_ptem` | Lowest-level potential temperature | = `Sa_tbot`: CAM's T (ps/p)^κ ([CAM](https://github.com/ESCOMP/CAM/blob/cam6_4_187/src/control/camsrfexch.F90#L496)) with p = `PS` | `TREFHT` | [282](datm:L282) |
| `Sa_u10m`, `Sa_v10m` | 10 m wind, zonal and meridional | `U10` speed along `UBOT`/`VBOT`; 0 where `UBOT`/`VBOT` is 0 | `U10`, `UBOT`, `VBOT` | [290–300](datm:L290-L300) |
| `Faxa_snowc` | Convective snow | unit conversion, m/s → kg/m²/s | `PRECSC` {bdg-primary}`h4` | [308](datm:L308) |
| `Faxa_snowl` | Large-scale snow | unit conversion, m/s → kg/m²/s | `PRECSL` {bdg-primary}`h4` | [309](datm:L309) |
| `Sa_dens` | Lowest-level air density | {bdg-info}`computed` | `PS` / (Rd `TREFHT` (1 + zvir `QREFHT`)) | [283](datm:L283) |
| `Faxa_rainc` | Convective rain | {bdg-info}`computed` | (`PRECC` − `PRECSC`) × 1000 {bdg-primary}`h4` | [306](datm:L306) |
| `Faxa_rainl` | Large-scale rain | {bdg-info}`computed` | (`PRECT` − `PRECC` − `PRECSL`) × 1000 {bdg-primary}`h4` | [307](datm:L307) |
| `Faxa_swvdr` | Downward shortwave, visible direct | {bdg-info}`computed` | (`FSDS` − `SOLSD` − `SOLLD`) × 0.475 {bdg-primary}`h4` | [314](datm:L314) |
| `Faxa_swndr` | Downward shortwave, near-IR direct | {bdg-info}`computed` | (`FSDS` − `SOLSD` − `SOLLD`) × 0.525 {bdg-primary}`h4` | [294](datm:L294) |
| `Sa_topo` | Surface height (topography) | DATM's observed topography stream | — | [263](datm:L263) |

Direct shortwave is split in JRA's 0.28 : 0.31 ratio. `Faxa_swdn`, `Faxa_prect`, `Faxa_precc`,
`Faxa_precsc` and `Faxa_precsl` are read only as inputs to the computed fields.

### DOCN

| Coupler field | Meaning | How it's made | From MESACLIP | Line |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `So_t` | Sea-surface temperature | unit conversion, °C → K | `SST` | [228–230](docn:L228-L230) |
| `So_s` | Sea-surface salinity | unit conversion, kg/kg → g/kg (= psu) | `SSS` | [212](docn:L212) |
| `So_u`, `So_v` | Surface current, east and north | cm/s → m/s, rotated from POP's grid axes with `ANGLE` | `U1_1`, `V1_1`, `ANGLE` | [177](docn:L177), [184](docn:L184), [189–197](docn:L189-L197) |
| `So_omask` | Ocean fraction of each cell | ocean fraction of the model mesh | — | [153](docn:L153) |
| `So_bldepth` | Ocean boundary-layer depth | 0, no stream (WW3 doesn't use it) | — | [204](docn:L204) |

`SSS` files hold kg/kg although their units attribute says g/kg.

### DICE

Only `Si_ifrac` and `Si_thick` come from MESACLIP; the rest is made as DICE%SSMI does.

| Coupler field | Meaning | How it's made | From MESACLIP | Line |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Si_ifrac` | Ice fraction | unit conversion, % → fraction, clipped to 0–1¹ | `aice_d` | [418](dice:L418), [448](dice:L448), [511–519](dice:L511-L519) |
| `Si_thick` | Ice thickness (WW3 reads it only with CICE) | `hi_d` ÷ final ice fraction where there is ice, else 0, as CICE does | `hi_d`, `aice_d` | [567–574](dice:L567-L574) |
| `Si_imask` | Ice mask | ice mask of the model mesh | — | [251](dice:L251) |
| `Si_t` | Ice surface temperature | made up: 260 ± 10 K seasonal cycle, pulled toward freezing | — | [451–455](dice:L451-L455), [529](dice:L529) |
| `Si_avsdr`, `Si_anidr`, `Si_avsdf`, `Si_anidf` | Ice albedo, 4 bands | fixed albedos | — | [458–461](dice:L458-L461) |
| `Faii_swnet` | Net shortwave into the ice | DATM's 4 bands × (1 − albedo) | via DATM | [466–469](dice:L466-L469) |
| `Faii_*` (6 fields), `Si_tref`, `Si_qref` | Ice-atmosphere fluxes and stress; 2 m T, q | bulk formula from DATM and `Si_t` | via DATM | [533–538](dice:L533-L538) |
| `Fioi_melth`, `Fioi_meltw` | Melt heat, meltwater | from the ocean's `Fioo_q` and ice fraction | — | [472–525](dice:L472-L525) |
| `Fioi_swpen` | Shortwave through the ice | `flux_swpf` (default 0) × `Faii_swnet` | — | [552](dice:L552) |
| `Fioi_taux`, `Fioi_tauy` | Ice-ocean stress | = `Faii_taux`, `Faii_tauy` | — | [555–556](dice:L555-L556) |
| `Fioi_salt` | Salt flux, ice to ocean | 0 | — | [559](dice:L559) |
| `Fioi_bcpho`, `Fioi_bcphi`, `Fioi_flxdst` | Black carbon, dust to ocean | DATM's aerosol deposition | — | [576–579](dice:L576-L579) |
| `Si_ifrac_n`, `Fioi_swpen_ifrac_n` | Per-category ice fraction, shortwave | one category (per-category coupling only) | — | [585–586](dice:L585-L586) |

¹ With `flux_qacc` (default on), at least 0.01 where there is ice.

## MESACLIP variables not used yet

In the files ([variable glossary](mesaclip_experiments.md#variable-glossary)) but not in any stream:

| MESACLIP variable | Meaning | File | Could provide | Instead of |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SSH_2` | Sea-surface height | `pop.h.nday1` | `So_dhdx`, `So_dhdy` from its gradient² | not supplied |
| `Tsfc_d` | Snow/ice surface temperature | `cice.h1` | `Si_t` | DICE's made-up seasonal value |
| `fswthru_d` | Shortwave through the ice to the ocean | `cice.h1` | `Fioi_swpen` | 0 |

² Needs preprocessing on the tripole grid.

## Stream parameters

Tag meanings: [CDEPS streams docs](https://escomp.github.io/CDEPS/versions/master/html/streams.html).

| Tag | cam.h2 | cam.h4 | pop.h.nday1 | cice.h1 |
|-----|--------|--------|-------------|---------|
| `taxmode` | `extend` | `extend` | `extend` | `extend` |
| `tintalgo` | `linear` | `nearest`; `coszen` for shortwave | `nearest` | `nearest` |
| `offset` (s) | `0` | `-10800`; `-21600` for shortwave | `-43200` | `-43200` |
| `readmode` | `single` | `single` | `single` | `single` |
| `dtlimit` | `1.e30` | `1.e30` | `1.e30` | `1.e30` |

- **`offset`:** `cam.h2` is snapshots; `cam.h4`, `pop.h.nday1` and `cice.h1` are means stamped at
  the window's end, so half a window back centres them for `nearest`. `coszen` takes the stamp as the
  window's start, so shortwave goes back a whole window, as CDEPS's JRA streams do.
- **Years:** `year_first`/`year_last` = `DATM_YR_START`/`END`, `year_align` = `year_first`, so model
  years are data years.
- **`extend`:** daily means start Jan 1 12:00 after the offset, so a run starting Jan 1 needs the
  first record held. A run past `year_last` also holds the last record without an error.
- **`dtlimit = 1.e30`:** CDEPS's gap check is off; `%daterange` stops the setup on a missing year
  or gap instead.

## Meshes and remapping

| History files | Mesh | `mapalgo` |
|---|---|---|
| `cam.h2`, `cam.h4` | `share/meshes/ne120np4_ESMFmesh_cdf5_c20211018.nc` | `bilinear` |
| `pop.h.nday1`, `cice.h1` | `share/meshes/tx0.1v2_ESMFmesh_cd5_c20210105.nc` | `bilinear` |

Mesh paths are under CESM inputdata. CAM-SE winds are already east/north.

**Currents** follow POP's tripole axes. At init the DOCN datamode reads `ANGLE`, regrids its cos and
sin with the current stream's weights and renormalizes ([236–349](docn:L236-L349)); each step it
rotates as POP's coupler does ([189–197](docn:L189-L197)). Where the regridded cos/sin is shorter
than 0.5 (stencil across the Arctic fold), the current is 0 ([335–341](docn:L335-L341)). Verified on
tx0.1 to 5e-8 against `ANGLE`-rotated GDEX currents. Currents sit on U points but are read on the
T-point mesh.

## Where the stream XML comes from

`code/claude/mesaclip.py` holds the tables on this page; `code/claude/add_mesaclip_to_cesm.py`
writes them into CDEPS's `stream_definition_{datm,docn,dice}.xml`
([Adding MESACLIP to CDEPS](adding_mesaclip_to_cdeps.md#finding-the-files)).
